tickets.title: Return a compact actionable hud_read list; keep recent history on demand
tickets.what:
Implement [the list contract](../spec.md) in one vertical slice. A model polling `hud_read({})` should receive the IDs and facts it can act on, not a copy of its recent job history. Keep the old result available explicitly.


**Delivery:** One `imp`, package `mcp-read-compact`, in its own worktree. No functional dependency on `mcp-next`; coordinate with its writers of `thin-main.ts`, `role-client.ts` and `thin-mcp.test.mjs` rather than racing their edits. Preserve landed features. Budget: roughly 100 production/schema lines and at most two new main-path tests, reusing existing fixtures. Build the HUD and MCP and run the affected thin-MCP tests (including pi schema parity) once on Node 24 with temporary homes. No self-review, new dependencies or benchmarking suite. If it requires a storage/lifecycle change or a broader tool rewrite, stop and report.

acceptance.text: Implement `view?: "compact" | "recent"` on the no-job path in `packages/hud-mcp/src/thin-main.ts`; keep the real MCP tool description/schema and `PI_ROLE_TOOLS` in `src/harness/pi/role-client.ts` in sync. Reject invalid/list-only argument combinations as specified. Keep the top-level `jobs` array in both modes.

Verify the actual `tools/call` response with synthetic data: 4 ordinary working jobs + 1 closed job with an unread report + 15 settled/handled jobs yields **5 short rows by default vs. the same 20 legacy rows in `recent`**. Ordinary rows have exactly `job`, `role`, `state`. The unread row survives a second poll with no changes; adding newer handled history cannot push it out of compact. Record both model-visible `content[0].text` UTF-8 byte sizes on the same quiet fixture and the percentage saved; bytes are not tokens.

Use existing cases to verify a pending question carries its `qN` ID, a block/wait or unobserved failure keeps its actionable reason, and an observed failure with no other pending item is history. Preserve once-only `changes` even for hidden rows and existing watcher metadata. Neither list reads report/question bodies, stamps `read_at`/`observed_at` nor triggers read-close. Single-job `wait_ms`, `report_unchanged` and `full:true` continue to work as before.

Migrate any in-tree history/full-row consumers to `view:"recent"` before flipping the default; keep legacy assertions (notably the STATUS parity table in `tests/unit/thin-mcp.test.mjs`) on that path instead of deleting coverage. Update `packages/hud-mcp/README.md`, `docs/reference.md` and the shipped `hud-delegate` list guidance. Do not change the panel or watch/event policy to make a test pass.

comments.author: orchestrator
comments.text: verified on universal-hud (e629b295), Node v24.22.1, temp homes: build, build:test, build:hud-mcp pass; thin-mcp + pi-package + hud-watch 148/148. Actual tools/call content[0].text on the quiet fixture (4 working, 1 closed sonic with unread report, 15 handled): default 327 bytes / 5 rows, recent 4,475 bytes / 20 rows, 92.69% saved (bytes, not tokens). Second quiet poll keeps report_unread:true and leaves the report unread; newer handled jobs push it out of recent, not compact; their changes still arrive once.
